name: PixelArt Importer
description: Import raster images into the Geometry Dash level editor as coloured blocks.

pixel-scale.name: Pixel block size
pixel-scale.description: Smaller values make each imported square smaller and pack the image more tightly.

quality.name: Import quality
quality.description: Higher quality creates more pixel objects. Level 4 can create up to 20,000 objects and may slow down mobile devices.
